# ARC Factory Presets

<!-- Generated by the `library / every preset is clean, truthful and unique` test from the factory
     library and its measurements (a full, unfiltered run). Do not edit by hand. -->

396 presets in 12 categories: the 46 signature sounds and a 350-preset library. Every preset listed here was rendered and measured by the library audit on this build (C3-E3-G3 chord held for 2 s, then a single A3):

| Check | Rule | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Clean | finite, DC below -30 dB, peak below -1 dBFS on the chord and on hard single notes (C2, C4, C6 at full velocity) | 396 of 396 |
| Level | chord at -21 dB momentary loudness +-2 dB, or held back by the -3 dBFS peak ceiling (short hits) | 396 of 396, -34.1 to -21.0 dB |
| In tune | A3 within 12 cents and within 30 dB of the strongest partial (percussion, experimental and presets tagged inharmonic, unpitched, noise, detuned or chaos are exempt) | 289 of 289 checked |
| True to category | plucked, struck, bowed and air use their exciter; glass, metal, wood and membrane their material; pads and drones hold within 10 dB; percussion falls at least 18 dB | 396 of 396 |
| Unique | no two presets closer than 2.0 (spectral shape, envelope, stereo width, modulation) | closest 2.13 (Reed Array / Sheng Cluster) |

Per-preset measurements: [measurements/presets/library.csv](measurements/presets/library.csv). Rebuild the
catalogue with `ARCTests "clean, truthful"`; after changing a preset, re-run the loudness calibration first
(`ARC_CALIBRATE=1 ARCTests "calibrate loudness"`, see TESTING.md).

## How the presets are made

Presets are written with a small fluent builder (`Source/Core/PresetBuilder.h`, one file per category in
`Source/Core/Presets/`). Values are plain parameter values; anything a preset leaves alone takes its default.

* **Tuning.** A node's radius reaches one octave either side of its material ratio (glass 2.63 / 4.45 / 6.55 / 9.40,
  metal 1.19 / 1.5 / 2.0 / 2.67, wood 2.76 / 5.40 / 8.93 / 13.34, membrane 1.59 / 2.14 / 2.30 / 2.65 x CORE, stretched
  by TENSION and INHARMONICITY). `tune()` places a node exactly on a ratio; `chord()` folds an out-of-reach ratio by
  octaves, the way a sympathetic string would be tuned (20 presets fold at least one node; the audit prints each fold). A radius
  that would need clamping fails `factory library is complete and valid`.
* **Sustained exciters keep every node at least 5 % from unison.** A bowed or blown CORE locks onto one side of a
  near-unison doublet and plays sharp: Obsidian Bloom played 66 to 81 cents sharp until its node A moved from
  1.036 to 1.11 x CORE.
* **Strongly blown skins keep MASS at 0.6 or more.** A membrane's tension rises with amplitude and a self-sustaining
  air drive never lets it settle: Mirliton (FLOW 0.72) read +12 cents at MASS 0.46 and +1.6 at 0.62. The breathy
  membrane pads (FLOW 0.62 or less with high TURBULENCE, a weaker drive) stay within 4 cents at MASS 0.40 to 0.58.
* **Metal harmonic chords (2, 3, 4, 5) need TENSION near 0.7** to sit inside the nodes' reach.
* **Loudness.** Each preset stores a PATCH LEVEL trim, measured on the chord and capped so that neither the chord
  nor a hard single note anywhere from C2 to C6 peaks above -3 dBFS (where the output's safety clip begins). Each
  note keeps the trim of the patch it was played in, so switching presets never lifts a ringing tail. MASTER stays
  yours.
* **Recall.** CHAOS and MOTION walks are seeded from the preset name, so a preset sounds the same every time.
* **Motion.** Procedural gestures (orbit, sway, figure, breathe, steps, wander) are stored with the preset;
  stepped gestures are exact semitones with QUANTISE on.
